The institutional investor held 489,779 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.92M, up from 461,866 at the end of the previous reported quarter. (NYSE:VZ) has declined 3.72% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.27% the S&P500.
